items.description: STAT!Ref offers healthcare information in desktop and laptop modalities. The organization has released a mobile application that requires an online subscription. In this app, users can find content targeted to academic institutions, healthcare organizations, government, military, and public health.
Displays mountain biking routes in North Yorkshire. It displays both where each route is and the actual route. The site uses Ajax to get a list of points of interest and polylines.
Facebook application for searching, rating, reviewing, and sharing summer camps. Put your favorite camps on the map and meet other friends who share the same experiences.

This map and table application displays historical and cultural monuments in Los Angeles, with a focus on monuments that celebrate diversity, democracy, and freedom. Includes descriptions and Flickr photos for over 900 monuments.
iPhoneRevu is a map and list view of Yelp Reviews formated for the iPhone. iPhoneRevu is a Yelp front-end for the iPhone.
Zeiss European store finder for Germany.
